# Tofugu

> > A Japanese culture and language learning resource exploring everything from Edo period history to modern anime, with practical guides for learners and travelers.

Tofugu offers in-depth articles on Japanese culture, history, and language learning, combining educational content about traditional customs (sento bathhouses, washitsu rooms) with contemporary topics (Studio Ghibli, video games) and practical advice for English teachers in Japan through the JET Program.

## Key Topics

- Japanese language learning
- Edo period history
- Japanese culture and customs
- Cultural differences (Japan vs. West)
- Japanese cuisine and food traditions
- JET Program and teaching English in Japan
- Studio Ghibli and anime culture
- Traditional Japanese architecture (washitsu, tatami)
- Onsen and sento bathhouses
- Tokugawa period
- Nintendo DS language learning
- Japanese-American artists
- Video game culture
- Japanese etiquette and social customs

## Japanese Language Learning

- [Learn Japanese with Nintendo DS](https://www.tofugu.com/japanese/learn-japanese-nintendo-ds): Guide to best Nintendo DS games for studying Japanese and kanji
- [10 Reasons a Japanese Girlfriend Won't Help Your Japanese](https://www.tofugu.com/japanese/japanese-girlfriends-and-learning-japanese): Why dating Japanese speakers doesn't guarantee language learning success

## Japanese Culture and Customs

- [Sento Bathhouses in Japan: What Not to Do](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/sento): Sento bathhouse etiquette guide covering customs and cultural mistakes
- [Washitsu Is a Room With Many Uses.](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/washitsu): Traditional Japanese washitsu rooms with tatami mats and shoji doors
- [Why Do Japanese People Wear Surgical Masks?](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/surgical-masks): Cultural reasons behind surgical mask wearing in Japan
- [Purikura: The Joy of Japanese Photo Booths](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/purikura): Guide to Japanese purikura photo booths and kawaii editing techniques
- [Japanese Schools vs American Schools](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/japanese-schools-vs-american-schools): Comparing Japanese and American education systems for JET teachers
- [The Cicadas' Song: Japan's Summer Soundtrack](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/cicadas-in-japan): Cicadas as cultural symbols and sounds of Japanese summer

## Japanese History

- [Rice: The Crop That Sparked the Tokugawa Miracle](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/rice-in-japan): How rice transformed Japan during the Tokugawa/Edo period
- [Japanese Fart Scrolls](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/fart-scrolls): Exploring He-Gassen fart scrolls from Edo period Japanese art history
- [Bishounen](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/bishounen): Bishounen male beauty ideals in anime, manga, and Japanese history

## Japanese Food and Cuisine

- [Tamago Kake Gohan: The Japanese Egg Feast](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/tamago-kake-gohan-raw-egg-on-rice): Traditional Japanese raw egg rice breakfast dish tamago kake gohan
- [Let's Nabe! Tofugu's Guide to Japanese Hot Pot Cooking](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/nabe-hot-pot): Beginner's guide to cooking Japanese nabe hot pot with donabe
- [Japanese Delicacies? Or something… Else?](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/japanese-delicacy): Exploring chinmi rare Japanese delicacies like uni and karasumi

## Travel and Hidden Japan

- [Hitou: 10 Secret Onsen in Japan](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/hitou-secret-onsen): Guide to 10 remote hitou secret hot springs across Japan

## Anime, Manga, and Pop Culture

- [Studio Ghibli Books: The Inspiration for the Films](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/studio-ghibli-books): Book adaptations behind Studio Ghibli and Miyazaki anime films

## Teaching English in Japan

- [ESL Bulletin Board Ideas for JET Program ALTs](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/esl-bulletin-board-ideas): Bulletin board ideas for JET Program ALTs teaching English in Japan

## Optional

- [Interview with Ken Taya, aka Enfu](https://www.tofugu.com/interviews/enfu): Interview with Japanese American artist Enfu on East-West mashup art
- [The Art of Proposing To A Japanese Girl](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/proposing-to-a-japanese-girl): Cross-cultural marriage proposal customs and Japanese dating traditions
- [The Secret World Of Kisha Clubs And Japanese Newspapers](https://www.tofugu.com/japan/kisha-clubs-and-japanese-newspapers): Inside kisha clubs and Japanese journalism press freedom issues
